mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_follow WHERE follower_id=#{from} AND followee_id=#{to}

choose.when: SELECT f.id AS relation_id,u.id,u.nickname,u.bio,u.avatar_media_id FROM t_follow f JOIN t_user u ON u.id=f.follower_id WHERE f.followee_id=#{user} AND f.id<#{before} AND u.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{size}
choose.otherwise: SELECT f.id AS relation_id,u.id,u.nickname,u.bio,u.avatar_media_id FROM t_follow f JOIN t_user u ON u.id=f.followee_id WHERE f.follower_id=#{user} AND f.id<#{before} AND u.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{size}

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_follow WHERE follower_id=#{user}) AS following_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_follow WHERE followee_id=#{user2}) AS follower_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_note WHERE author_id=#{user3} AND status='PUBLISHED') AS note_count,(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.like_count+m.favorite_count),0) FROM t_note n JOIN t_note_metric m ON m.note_id=n.id WHERE n.author_id=#{user4} AND n.status='PUBLISHED') AS appreciation_count,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_follow WHERE follower_id=#{viewer} AND followee_id=#{user5}) AS following
